scripts.dev: npm run build -w app && wrangler dev
scripts.deploy:staging: npm run build:app && wrangler deploy --env staging -c wrangler.staging.ci.toml
scripts.deploy:production: npm run build:app && wrangler deploy --env production -c wrangler.production.ci.toml
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w app && npm run typecheck -w worker
